title: 2024 TTX · contested CCA logistics
subtitle: Forward posture, prepositioning, munitions limits, EW trade-offs
description: Mitchell Institute 2024 tabletop-exercise logistics assessments: CCA forward posture in southern Japan and northern Philippines, prepositioned stocks, contested airlift and munitions shortages, and changing kinetic versus electronic-attack CCA sortie mixes.
assumptions: The report identifies southern Japan, Ryukyus, northern Philippines and broader supporting regions, but not actual airfield-level positions or routes for this visual; current map coordinates are fictional editorial markers.

Reported constrained planning outcomes include sweep team sorties shifting from 96% weapon launch / 4% EW-decoy to 68% / 32%, and SEAD from 76% / 24% to 33% / 67% (Figure 12, p. 25). These are planning shares, not simulated sortie outcomes.
The 145% cumulative requested-versus-available expendable CCA inventory statistic derives from Figure 11; the map does not model quantities, replenishment, attrition or combat outcomes.
Timeline seconds, flight paths and unit offsets are illustrations; not the TTX's recorded logistics flows.

phases.title: Preposition CCA and Munitions
phases.narrative: The teams proposed prepositioning replacement CCA and munitions before contested theater movements (pp. 19, 24).

phases.title: Distributed Launch Posture
phases.narrative: Teams considered dispersed sites in southern Japan and northern Philippines to generate CCA sorties closer to the fight (pp. 4, 24).

phases.title: Sortie Generation Requirements
phases.narrative: The report assessed fuel, munitions, personnel and airlift required for first-week sorties without publishing site-specific generation schedules.

phases.title: Resupply Risk and Theater Lift
phases.narrative: The teams treated C-130 resupply near threatened forward sites as high risk and discussed air-launched CCA and alternate resupply methods (p. 24).

phases.title: Adapt Under Munitions Constraints
phases.narrative: Dispersed operating concepts and off-runway options were intended to complicate enemy targeting (pp. 4, 24).

phases.title: Constrained Logistics Findings
phases.narrative: Munitions shortages drove shifts toward EW and decoy CCA; Figure 12 quantifies constrained versus unconstrained sortie-mix estimates.
